subject: Interim SOC 2 affirmation requested to cover audit-period gap
messages:
From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha.ruiz@aureliahealth.org>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@aureliahealth.org>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Interim SOC 2 statement to cover post-report period

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

We're progressing through Aurelia's procurement security review and we have one remaining ask before legal signs off: a short interim assurance statement that confirms Redwood's controls posture from the SOC 2 Type II report end date through today. Our contract review needs confirmation that there were no significant control changes, incidents, or third-party shifts since the report period ended (report end date: 2025-12-31).

Specifically our checklist requests:
- A signed interim statement or bridge-style letter referencing the SOC 2 Type II report (signed by a security exec)
- A controls matrix extract showing any control changes since 2026-01-01
- Audit log extracts for May 2026 for incident/ops review (redacted as needed)
- Confirmation of KMS/HSM usage and key-rotation cadence since the report end date

We have a copy of the SOC 2 report on file (attached) but procurement insists on a dated affirmation for the period between 2026-01-01 and today to cover the gap. Can you confirm whether you can provide this and an approximate timeline?

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager | Aurelia Health

Subject: Re: Request: Interim SOC 2 statement to cover post-report period

Hi Samantha — thank you for the clear list. We can provide an interim assurance statement to cover the period from 2026-01-01 through 2026-06-01.

Next steps from our side:
1) Security will draft a short, signed interim statement that references the SOC 2 Type II report and confirms there were no material changes to the control environment or reportable incidents during the requested period.
2) We'll include a controls-change summary (high-level) and a bundle of supporting artifacts (controls matrix extract, KMS confirmation, and filtered audit logs for May).
3) Please confirm whether a CISO signature on Redwood letterhead is required (we can obtain that) and whether DocuSign is acceptable.

Proposed timeline:
- Draft interim statement (security) — within 2 business days
- Internal review and obtain signature — 1 business day after draft
- Deliver evidence bundle (controls matrix + redacted logs) — concurrently with signed statement

Soojin (cc'd) — can you take point on the draft and evidence packaging? Marissa — looping you in for any contract notes or special language Aurelia needs on the statement.

Samantha, please confirm the exact procurement signatory and whether you require the statement to reference specific control IDs from the SOC 2 (e.g., CC6.1, CC7.2) or if a high-level affirmation is sufficient for legal.

Best,

Subject: Draft interim assurance statement and evidence plan (for Aurelia Health)

Hi Samantha / Karthik / Marissa,

Attached is a proposed interim assurance statement (PDF) that we prepared to cover the period 2026-01-01 through 2026-06-01. Summary of what it contains:

- A brief affirmation referencing our SOC 2 Type II report (period ending 2025-12-31) and stating that there were no material changes to the control environment or reportable security incidents during the interim period.
- A bullet list of the evidence we will provide: controls matrix extract (changes highlighted), KMS key-rotation log summary, list of subprocessors unchanged since report, and redacted May 2026 audit log extracts for the security/ops events requested.
- A note that this statement is not a replacement for the SOC 2 report and does not constitute an auditor opinion; it is an internal management affirmation intended to bridge the audit-period gap.

Attachments included here: interim_assurance_statement_20260602.pdf (pdf) and a packaging checklist. We will produce filtered logs with column-level redaction before delivery. If Aurelia requires raw logs, we will need an executed NDA/secure transfer arrangement.

If this language looks fine to Aurelia, we will obtain a CISO-level signature (or VP Security) and deliver via DocuSign. We can also add references to specific control IDs if you confirm which ones your legal/procurement reviewers want called out.

Proposed delivery: signed statement + evidence bundle by end of day Thursday, 2026-06-03.

Soojin Lee

Thanks — quick responses from procurement/legal below (cc'd):

- Letter: procurement prefers CISO signature on company letterhead and DocuSign delivery.
- Control references: legal asks that the statement reference CC6.1 (logical access) and CC7.1 (change management) by ID and confirm no exceptions were identified during the interim period. High-level language is okay but please include those two control references.
- Logs: redacted extracts are fine; please include the May 2026 extracts with event-type columns (timestamp, event_type, outcome). If you can deliver a CSV extract for those three columns that would be ideal.

If you can confirm signatory and send DocuSign by Thursday EOD, we can finish the procurement checklist and move to signature.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.
Samantha
